Universal Human Values (UHV) Notes
Introduction to Universal Human Values (UHV)

Universal Human Values (UHV) is a subject that helps individuals understand:

The purpose of life
Harmony in self, family, society, and nature
Ethical and moral values
Right understanding and right living

The goal of UHV is to create a happy, prosperous, and peaceful society.

1. Need for Value Education
Why Value Education is Important
Helps in developing good character
Builds responsibility and discipline
Improves relationships
Creates social harmony
Guides proper decision-making
Problems Without Values
Stress and depression
Corruption
Violence
Environmental destruction
Lack of trust in relationships
2. Self-Exploration
Meaning

Self-exploration means understanding:

What is right and wrong
What we truly want in life
Our natural acceptance

It is a process of:

Verification
Observation
Understanding oneself
Process of Self-Exploration
Desire
Thought
Expectation
Selection based on natural acceptance
3. Harmony in the Human Being

Human being consists of:

Self (I)
Body
Difference Between Self and Body
Self (I)	Body
Conscious entity	Physical entity
Experiences happiness	Needs physical facilities
Continuous	Temporary
Desires and thoughts	Biological activities
Needs of Self and Body
Needs of Self
Happiness
Trust
Respect
Peace
Needs of Body
Food
Clothing
Shelter
Physical protection
4. Happiness and Prosperity
Happiness

A state of harmony within oneself.

Sources of Happiness
Right understanding
Good relationships
Mutual trust
Prosperity

Feeling of having more than enough physical facilities.

Prosperity is not only wealth but also:

Satisfaction
Contentment
5. Harmony in Family

Family is the basic unit of society.

Important Values in Relationships
Trust
Respect
Affection
Care
Guidance
Reverence
Gratitude
Love
Trust

Assurance that the other person wants our happiness and prosperity.

Respect

Right evaluation of another person.

6. Harmony in Society
Goal of Society

An undivided society and universal order.

Requirements for Social Harmony
Justice
Equality
Fearlessness
Mutual prosperity
Comprehensive Human Goal
Right understanding
Prosperity
Fearlessness
Co-existence
7. Harmony in Nature

Nature consists of:

Material order
Plant order
Animal order
Human order
Importance of Nature
Provides resources
Maintains ecological balance
Supports life
Co-existence

Everything in nature exists in mutual harmony.

8. Professional Ethics
Meaning

Ethical behavior in professional life.

Characteristics
Honesty
Responsibility
Transparency
Accountability
Ethical Human Conduct
Working for social welfare
Avoiding exploitation
Sustainable development
9. Human Conduct

Human conduct means living with:

Right understanding
Right feelings
Right behavior
Values in Human Conduct
Truthfulness
Compassion
Justice
Non-violence
10. Holistic Perception of Harmony

Harmony should exist at four levels:

Individual
Family
Society
Nature

This leads to:

Peace
Happiness
Sustainable development
